sources.entry: WackoWiki - WackoWiki is a light and easy to install multilingual Wiki-engine. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause PHP

summary.one_liner: WackoWiki is a lightweight, multilingual wiki engine written in PHP that is meant to be easy to install.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes WackoWiki as a light, easy-to-install multilingual wiki engine. It names WYTIWYG (what you think is what you get) editing, page-level rights (ACLs), design themes (skins), file upload, and email notification as features, along with "much more" that is not itemized. It states compatibility with PHP 8.3 through 8.5 and with MariaDB, MySQL, and SQLite as database backends. The README is mostly links to a user guide, news, forums, SourceForge, GitHub, and an issue tracker, and it contains no installation commands or screenshots.
caveats: README gives no installation or run instructions; setup details must come from the user guide or elsewhere
README does not state platform limits beyond the listed PHP and database versions
